main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads a number of test cases; for each case, reads arrays a and b, computes previous/next greater-element boundaries, and accumulates weighted pair counts between a and b where the absolute value difference is <= k, printing the total per case." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read the number of test cases t from standard input using scanf("%d", &t). RESULT t]
            [COMMAND Begin a for loop with int m = 1; continue while m <= t; increment m by 1 at the end of each iteration. All following test-case steps are inside this loop. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Inside the loop over m, read n and k from standard input in a single scanf("%d%d", &n, &k). RESULT n,k]
            [COMMAND Inside the loop over m, declare variable-length arrays int a[n], b[n], l_a[n], l_b[n], r_a[n], r_b[n]. RESULT arrays]
            [COMMAND Inside the loop over m, for each index i from 0 to n-1, execute the initialization l_a[i] = l_b[i] = r_a[i] = r_b[i] = i. RESULT l_a,l_b,r_a,r_b]
            [COMMAND Inside the loop over m, for each index i from 0 to n-1, read one integer into a[i] using scanf("%d", a + i). RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Inside the loop over m, for each index i from 0 to n-1, read one integer into b[i] using scanf("%d", b + i). RESULT b]
            [COMMAND Inside the loop over m, for each index i from 0 to n-1, compute the four boundary arrays in exact order: set l_temp = i and while l_temp > -1 and a[l_temp] <= a[i], decrement l_temp, then store l_temp into l_a[i]; reset l_temp = i and while l_temp > -1 and b[l_temp] <= b[i], decrement l_temp, then store l_temp into l_b[i]; reset l_temp = i and while l_temp < n and a[l_temp] <= a[i], increment l_temp, then store l_temp into r_a[i]; reset l_temp = i and while l_temp < n and b[l_temp] <= b[i], increment l_temp, then store l_temp into r_b[i]. RESULT l_a,l_b,r_a,r_b]
            [COMMAND Inside the loop over m, set long long int tot = 0. RESULT tot]
            [COMMAND Inside the loop over m, in the first accumulation loop, for each i from 0 to n-1 and for each j from i to r_a[i]-1, if l_b[j] < i and a[i] - b[j] <= k and a[i] - b[j] >= -k, then compute the product (i - max(l_a[i], l_b[j])) * (min(r_a[i], r_b[j]) - j) in int arithmetic and add it to tot. RESULT tot]
            [COMMAND Inside the loop over m, in the second accumulation loop, for each i from 0 to n-1 and for each j from i+1 to r_b[i]-1, if l_a[j] < i and a[j] - b[i] <= k and a[j] - b[i] >= -k, then compute the product (i - max(l_b[i], l_a[j])) * (min(r_b[i], r_a[j]) - j) in int arithmetic and add it to tot. RESULT tot]
            [COMMAND Inside the loop over m, after both accumulation loops, print the line 'Case #%d: %lld\n' using the current m and tot. RESULT printed_output]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
